problems: The blind guess (a bird, swan or duck with a raised neck and head) does not match the intended subject. The figure reads as a boat or hull.

The blue silhouette is a real outline, but the gold lines form a closed polygon across it. The crown-to-starboard-shoulder gold line duplicates the blue edge, so the gold lines read as the figure rather than as stars joined to the silhouette.
The keel fin is a thin spike from the dome up to its tip (tip near (296,118), base near (292,195)). With the pennant lanterns beside the tip, it reads more like a mast or neck than a fin.
The dome is narrow and tall, with the crown near (275,218). The shoulders (port near (190,232), starboard near (306,264)) sit on a sharp corner rather than a rounded dome.
The lamps under the belly hang below the waterline (y about 380-400), outside the hull. On an upturned hull the belly faces up, so these lamps contradict the drawing.

Label collisions: 'tip of the keel fin' overlaps 'upper pennant lantern'; 'crown of the hull, top of th' is truncated and runs into the dome; 'port shoulder of the dome' overlaps the dome line; 'starboard waterline' collides with 'rounded stern'; 'lamp under the belly, amidships' runs into 'lamp under the stern'.
Unlabelled noise stars at about (113,333), (156,213) and (183,208) sit near the figure and read as stray marks.
output.advice: Redraw the silhouette so it clearly reads as an upturned hull, keeping the star ids and their parts. (1) Dome: make a broad, convex dome with the crown (68523) as the highest body point, about (290,200). Place the shoulders on the outer curve: port shoulder (69996) about (200,235), starboard shoulder (68002) about (370,240). (2) Hull base: the waterlines form the flat lower edge. Port waterline (71121) about (150,360), starboard waterline (67234) about (330,375). Rounded stern (65810) closes the right end near (420,380). (3) Keel fin: a short, clean fin rising from the crown, with tip (68245) and base (68282) spaced so the fin is distinct from the dome. Move the pennant lanterns (67464, 67472) off the fin tip so their labels do not collide. (4) Belly lamps (69191, 66821, 66657): place them inside or just above the hull outline, not below the waterline. (5) Remove the stray unlabelled stars near the figure. (6) Shorten or offset labels to fix the overlaps listed above.
